key_findings: Five weeks after SNI, H3K27Ac falls in LH and NAc and H3K4me1 falls in PAG, but not in VTA.
Some histone marks correlate with individual pain severity scores (PAG H3K4me1/me3, LH H3K4me3, NAc H3K27Ac).
